comment: STS_My_Pulse reads pulse_width only in its band-unlimited branch; the band-limited branch returns a table built from sin(j * x) / j over odd j, which is a fixed 50 per cent square, so the Pulse knob and the PW-In jack are inert whenever Band is set to Limited. The pulse-width attenuator runs 0 to 1, unlike the other three attenuators which run -1 to 1. The pitch knob is linear in Hz.
